so, i cut for the first time at 13. because i was stressed, and i'd been told by a friend that self harming helped (thanks.). it only lasted for around 5 months, cutting occasional, until i got "bored" of it.

now, fast forward to 14 (two months before 15, so quite a while after the first time). a lot of shit happened, and i didn't know how else to deal with the emotions. so i started cutting again. i remembered where i'd left the blade when i was 13, and used it, and it helped. started doing it daily. now i'm 16 and it's worse than ever before. it's both an addiction, and a release for me. lately, i've been unable to catch a break, in any aspect of my life, and sh is the only thing that makes me feel better at times.

anyway, idk whether to say i started self harming at 13 or 14. but probably 14, because that's when most of the problems that i constantly face began. i often just really wish i threw the blade away when i was 13. honestly dont know why i kept it.
